notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
You control a Samurai or Warrior that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any Samurai or Warrior you control as an attacker.
Norika triggers, allowing you to cast Second Chance from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
